featured_reviews.name: raj chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great gym to work out in. I have been working out in this gym for the past 4 months. I am listing down the pros and cons but according to me the pros supercede the cons in every aspect.

Pros
1. One of the most spacious gyms in lalbaug.
2. Steam facility is provided.
3. Good timings. 6 am to 11 pm mon-sat. 1 pm to 9pm sunday.
4. Budget friendly enough for a dayjob going individual.
5. Yoga session on every sunday at 12 pm.
6. All machines and dumbbells are imported and are built up of quality material.
7. Hygiene is very much maintained.

Cons.
1. The timings for the steam services could be increased. Currently it is 1 pm to 5 pm only on Sat-Sun.
2. Locker facility is not provided.
3. Only one out-flow of drinking water is provided.

In conclusion it is a great gym to work out in. If you are enthusiastic about working out and building a great body this is the gym to go for.
